what: a 4 mm chamfer on the top front edge of a cube with three square openings stays clear of the openings (they start 5 mm in)
method: cube 20 with three orthogonal 10x10 through openings (cross): union of the three bars 3*2000 - 3*1000 + 1000 = 4000, so V0 = 8000 - 4000 = 4000. The top front edge (y=0,z=20, length 20) is intact (the openings span 5..15 in the other axes), and a 4 mm setback stays inside the 5 mm between the edge and the openings: it removes 4^2/2 x 20 = 160, V = 3840.
